exposure: intraoperative antibiotic prophylaxis regimen (type, dosage, frequency of administration, duration)
outcome: Surgical Care Improvement Project (SCIP) guideline adherence rates
cohort: The study included 129 patients who underwent mucosa-violating head and neck oncologic surgery with free tissue transfer between March 2017 and June 2019 at a single academic center.
finding: Significant opportunities exist in SCIP guideline adherence rates for intraoperative antibiotic prophylaxis, with cefazolin/metronidazole showing a significantly higher rate of appropriate redosing compared to ampicillin-sulbactam.
